subject: Bat Room
text: Kill the bats in the bat-shaped room to open a doorway, then hit the switches in the top left and bottom right corners to reach the boss.

evidence.quote: Kill the enemies, then proceed to a room that's shaped like a bat. Kill the bats to open a doorway, then hit the switches in the top left and bottom right corners. The next room contains the boss.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Move forward immediately upon entering to avoid spikes from the floor, defeat the bats he shoots, and hit him before he teleports.

evidence.quote: First off, as soon as you enter the room, move forward a little bit. This is because a bunch of spikes will come out of the floor right away. He'll then shoot out some bats, which will come flying at you and attack you. Kill the bats and then hit him a few times before he teleports for the first time.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: In his second form, hold up to prevent the wind from his flapping wings from pushing you back into the spikes.

evidence.quote: After a bunch of hits, he'll change into his next form... He'll then flap his wings and shoot out wind that will attempt to push you back to the spikes that came at the start of the battle. Hold up as hard as you can to prevent him from doing this, because you're dead otherwise.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Hit Zoda with the mace when he is exposed.

evidence.quote: Instead, focus on hitting Zoda when you can, by using the mace and hitting him when he is exposed.

subject: Tetrad
text: Defeating Zoda-Y yields a tetrad and increases your life meter.

evidence.quote: Not much really happens here, you just get a tetrad, your life meter increases, and it's off to the next area...

subject: King Arthur
text: King Arthur asks you to clear the dragon from the cave and increases your life level.

evidence.quote: Go into the castle and talk to King Arthur... He will want you to clear out this mean, terrible dragon from the cave, since his knights are out on quests. He will thank you for accepting the quest by increasing your life level and bestowing upon you the honor of Knight of the Round Table

subject: Dragon's Cave
text: Kill all the blobs and stand near the middle top of the screen to fall through the floor to a platform with medicine.

evidence.quote: Kill all the blobs in here, and when you kill the last one, stand near the middle top of the screen to fall through the floor onto a platform. Get the medicine here

subject: Dragon's Cave
text: Head up the left passageway and hit skeletons to jump over them for a medicine, then go around to obtain yet another medicine.

evidence.quote: then go up the left passageway and hit the skeletons so they fall to the floor, then jump over them. Nab this medicine as well... Go around, get yet another medicine, then kill the enemy while standing in the middle of the room.

subject: Conveyor Belt Rooms
text: Navigate conveyor belt rooms with spikes: take the shortcut in room 1, go up then down in room 2, up and down in room 3, and down then in the middle in room 4 to collect hearts before the boss.

evidence.quote: The conveyor belt in here will move super fast, and spikes will form at the finish line. In the first room, take the shortcut. In the second room, go up, then down. In the third room, go up and down. In the fourth room, go down and then in the middle. Get the hearts and prepare yourself for a boss.

subject: Knight
text: Jump over the bullets the Knight shoots and aim the shockwave diagonally at him while riding conveyor belts.

evidence.quote: The knight will simply move back and forth, shooting bullets in two directions. Simply jump over the bullets as they come near you, and aim the shockwave diagonally at him

subject: Merlin
text: Merlin asks you to find the last tetrad and gives you the Ultra Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote: After defeating the boss, an owl will approach you, but of course we know it's Merlin... He asks you to find the last tetrad and put them all together, then gives you the Ultra Psychic Shockwave.

subject: Secret Passageway
text: Defeat enemies to open a secret passageway with hearts and bolas, hit the bottom left corner switch, and hit the right corner switch to get a Medicine.

evidence.quote: Get the hearts, then kill the enemies to open up a secret passageway containing some hearts and bolas, then hit the switch in the bottom left hand corner. Hit the switch in the right hand corner to get a Medicine

subject: Moving Balls Room
text: Jump across the moving platform to hit a switch, pass through the room with moving balls jumping over them to grab items, and hit the switch in the third row tile set to open the exit.

evidence.quote: Go into the next room, then jump on the moving platform and onto the platform. Get the hearts, then hit the switch. Go through the door it opens up, then kill the enemies, and move into the room with the moving balls. Grab the items here, jumping over the balls in the process, then exit the room. Hit the switches while avoiding the boulders that come out of the sky. The tile set in the third row has a switch that leads to the exit from this room.

subject: Dragon's Cave
text: Collect a medicine from the left path, defeat two enemies on the right to open a path to another medicine, and get hearts in the bottom left corner.

evidence.quote: Get the medicine from the left hand path, then go right. Kill the two enemies, then go through the path they opened up to get another medicine... Go back to the previous room, kill or avoid the enemies this time, then get the hearts in the bottom left hand corner.

subject: Dragon
text: The Dragon moves up firing in three directions and flies shooting bullets, while room spikes generate over time.

evidence.quote: He will slowly move up, firing shots in three different directions. Spikes will slowly start to generate across the room as well. When he gets near you, he will start to fly around in the air and shoot off more bullets.

subject: Dragon
text: Stay near the bottom right corner, jump to hit the Dragon's head with the shockwave weapon, and walk in circles to evade flying bullets.

evidence.quote: stay near the bottom right hand corner and jump while using the ultimate shockwave weapon to hit his head, then when he starts to fly, walk in a circle to avoid the bullets. The only way to kill him is by hitting his head

subject: Final Tetrad
text: Obtaining the final tetrad prompts Micah to ask you to return to C-Island.

evidence.quote: Hey, you got the final tetrad! Micah will beg you to go back to C-Island, the original island from the first game.

subject: Overworld
text: Follow the path to town, speak to the man, and enter the original cave.

evidence.quote: Follow the path to the town, talk to the man, then enter the original cave.

subject: Cave
text: Kill three snails to unlock the door, defeat all enemies in the second room, and step on the switch among the blue moving enemies to unlock the next room.

evidence.quote: move up a screen and kill the three snails to unlock a door. The next room has even more enemies to dispose of, so kill all of them and you'll get to move onto the next room. In here, you'll see some blue moving enemies... Step on the switch that you can find in this room to unlock the door, then proceed to the following room.

subject: Cave
text: Kill two snails and moving blue enemies to unlock the door, then jump on the upper corner leftmost tile to open a secret passage heading up.

evidence.quote: This room has two snails and some moving blue enemies, so kill all of them to unlock the door to the next room. This room has switches that allow you to move left or right, but don't go there, as you'll just end up in a room with some flying bat enemies. Instead, jump on the leftmost tile in the upper corner to unlock a secret passage, then go up to the next room.

subject: Cave
text: Kill two blue enemies to advance, unlock a chest with 25 chests, jump on revealed switches after killing snakes to unlock doors and 25 torches, and take the right skinny path to reach a medicine.

evidence.quote: Kill the blue enemies to unlock the door to the next room. In this room, unlock the chest first to get 25 chests, then unlock the door to the next room. Kill the snail and then two snakes... Jump on the tiles to reveal three switches. Jump on them to unlock two doors and a chest. Take the 25 torches from the chest, then go to the right through that skinny passageway to go to a room with a medicine.

subject: C-Serpent
text: Stand on the center of three tiles to throw weapons into C-Serpent's open mouth, jumping left or right to avoid the 80% fire attacks.

evidence.quote: Kill all the enemies in here to get to the first boss in the original game, C-Serpent... There are three tiles, and you can only stand in the center one and throw weapons in the snake's mouth when it's open. However, he shoots out fire from his mouth 80% or so of the time, so you have to jump left or right to the tiles to avoid this fire.

subject: Conveyor Belt
text: Follow the conveyor belt taking the bottom route to acquire medicines before refighting faster versions of previous bosses.

evidence.quote: You'll follow a conveyor belt, and take the bottom route to get a bunch of medicines. You'll have to face revamped versions of the previous bosses now. They are the same but faster.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Against Zoda-Z's initial form, avoid the matching tiny creatures and attack the differently colored creature.

evidence.quote: He will start off in a simple enough form. There's a bunch of tiny creatures, and one of them is differently colored. Avoid the attacks of the tiny ones that match, and focus on the different colored one. After you hit it a bunch of times, this form will be defeated.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Attack normal Zoda with the shockwave weapon while dodging bullets, and avoid his attacks if his shockwaves turn you into a boar.

evidence.quote: all the little tiny creatures will come together and you will see Zoda in his normal form now. He shoots bullets around the room and teleports around. Just attack him with the shockwave weapon over and over while avoiding the weak bullets he shoots out. He has an attack that sends shockwaves out and turns you into a boar.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Do not touch minotaur Zoda while he spins and becomes invincible, anticipate wall fire shots, and dodge his charging head-first attack.

evidence.quote: Once you take care of that form, he'll turn into a minotaur... If he spins around, this makes him invincible for a little bit, so don't try to touch him until the effect wears off. He can also shoot fire off from both sides of the wall... And finally, he has a charge attack where he'll just come out of nowhere and try to slam into you head first.

subject: Zoda-Z
text: Defeating Zoda-Z allows you to beat the game and watch the ending.

evidence.quote: Hey, you beat the game! Congratulation, a winner is you! Sit back and watch the well deserved ending

subject: Zoda's Creature
text: During the Zoda's Creature fight, jump down off the bottom platform back to dry land below.

evidence.quote: during the Zoda's Creature fight, you have to jump down off the bottom platform back to dry land below.

subject: Zoda-Y
text: Save medicines and throw shooting stars at Zoda-Y a few at a time to deal with the moving platforms.

evidence.quote: Zoda-Y is hard because of the platforms that move you. Your best bet is to have a few medicines saved, and just throw a few shooting stars at him at a time.
